notes.title: DEMO UPDATE
notes.notes:
[b]📢 Major Demo Update – Just in Time for Launch![/b]

Hello, colleagues!

We’re thrilled to share that the demo for Hired 2 Die has been updated with a host of improvements and enhancements as we gear up for the official release on [b]January 31st[/b]. Here’s what’s new:

[b][u]Highlights of the Update[/u][/b]

🌟 [b]Enhanced Lighting & Performance[/b]
Experience a more immersive atmosphere with updated lighting.
Optimized performance to ensure smoother gameplay on a variety of systems.

🐛 [b]Bug Fixes Galore[/b]
Addressed numerous bugs reported by our amazing community. Thank you for your feedback!

🌎 [b]Expanded Accessibility[/b]
Added [b]Chinese servers[/b] for better regional connectivity.
Improved localization across supported languages.

📚 [b]Detailed Tutorial[/b]
The tutorial has been refined to make it easier for new players to understand the game’s mechanics.

🎮 [b]Gameplay Improvements[/b]
Adjusted level design and balance for a more challenging yet fair experience.
Introduced new sound effects, including character-specific cough and exhaustion sounds, and additional audio for enemies.

💾 [b]Cloud Saving[/b]
Your progress is now safer than ever with [b]cloud saving[/b] enabled.

🔧 [b]Stability & Connectivity[/b]
Enhanced stability and improved server connections for a more reliable multiplayer experience.
This update represents our continued commitment to delivering the best possible experience for our players. We’re counting down the days to launch, and we can’t wait for you to see everything we’ve been working on!

[b]📌 Mark your calendars: [i]Hired 2 Die[/i] officially launches on January 31st. Add it to your wishlist now![/b] 👉 https://store.steampowered.com/app/1729140/Hired_2_Die/

Thank you for your support—let’s make this launch unforgettable!

notes.title: Devlog #014 | Major Demo Update!
notes.notes:
Welcome, everyone! We're thrilled to announce a host of exciting new features coming to our demo. First and foremost, you can now play with up to 4 players!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41320579/4b2e8c19bcbe3d948f04bc10ebf75338c561795d.gif[/img]

Enjoy any contract with 1 to 4 players in co-op mode. Gather your friends and prepare for the shift of your lives!

[h2][b]PERKS AND LOBBY CUSTOMIZATION[/b][/h2]

Intersection has granted you the ability to purchase new anomalous furniture that empowers your character with unique abilities. These range from increased running speed to using cameras to help your friends and disable monsters.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41320579/0a9784e48715bb4f98d743757c145c0868fb7533.gif[/img]

Plus, these items can make your apartment look incredibly stylish!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41320579/95f1c3c638832eff4afe93dcabd7e264d837d70f.gif[/img]

[h2][b]RESULTS AND SECRETS[/b][/h2]

Your performance at the end of each contract is now graded. Discover the secrets hidden in each contract to earn an extra positive rank.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41320579/c1354d86c3d844a2c6ddb32c1df6bf6efb4bc3b6.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]IMPROVED VOIP SYSTEM[/b][/h2]

We’re introducing a new voice transmission system, now available for testing in the demo. Voices will better reflect your surroundings and distance from other players. Additionally, you can use the security system to communicate with other players. Simply find the CCTV in the room where the player you want to talk to is located, activate it, and start chatting.

[h2][b]NEW SECURITY CAMERA MECHANICS[/b][/h2]

Combat the distortions in your workplace with new tools. Use the UV Light positioned in security cameras to impair affected distortions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41320579/ffc91b5f603b9c57e99c7bc510b7aeea17072a54.gif[/img]

Additionally, a zoom feature interacts with enemies and allies if you have the correct perk. Lights, which previously could only be controlled via the security system, now have switches in all rooms. Be mindful of the energy cost!

[h2][b]INTERFACE REVAMP[/b][/h2]

We’ve redesigned all game interfaces to better align with the game's atmosphere.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41320579/09f392fde64f315c7c9bfca6937e66fd82a0a39d.png[/img]

Tooltips have been added to important interface elements, making it easier for new players to get started.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41320579/918cfc28f7b1d71fadcc38292a674dce46abe4f5.png[/img]


[h2][b]AND MUCH, MUCH MORE[/b][/h2]

Graphics have been improved, lore notes added, and new creature animations, sounds, and behaviors introduced. For a comprehensive list of updates, check our patch notes here: https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1729140/view/5956653982580523321.

We are nearing the opening of the Aethernus Casino. Grab the demo and explore the new features as you await the devious games of the ringmaster in the upcoming free Hired 2 Die: Prologue!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2460430/Hired_2_Die_Prologue/
